en.key: API key (saved by the shared backend, never in workspace settings)
en.endpoint: API endpoint (blank keeps the current or provider default)
en.save: Save shared provider settings? This does not test the endpoint or send a model request.
en.saved: Shared provider saved. Reconnect to start new conversations with this model; existing conversations keep their selection. No connection test was run.
en.conflict: Another client changed these settings. Reopen Configure API to read the current values; the credential was not rotated.
en.partial: Some shared settings were saved, but setup did not finish. Reopen Configure API to check the current provider and model before sending a message. No request was automatically retried.
en.node: DSH needs Node ^22.19.0 or >=24.0.0. Select a compatible Node executable, then reconnect.
en.home: The shared Harness home is not a usable directory. Select an existing or empty local folder; history is not moved.

zh-CN.key: API 密钥（由共享后台保存，不写入工作区设置）
zh-CN.endpoint: API 地址（留空保留当前地址或提供方默认值）
zh-CN.save: 保存共享提供方设置？此操作不会测试 API 地址或发送模型请求。
zh-CN.saved: 共享提供方已保存，重新连接后新会话使用此模型，已有会话保留原选择。未执行连接测试。
zh-CN.conflict: 另一客户端已修改这些设置。请重新配置 API 以读取当前值；密钥未被替换。
zh-CN.partial: 部分共享设置已保存，但配置尚未完成。发送消息前请重新配置 API，检查当前提供方和模型。不会自动重试请求。
zh-CN.node: DSH 需要 Node ^22.19.0 或 >=24.0.0。请选择兼容的 Node 可执行文件，然后重新连接。
zh-CN.home: 共享 Harness 主目录不是可用目录。请选择已有或空的本地文件夹；不会移动聊天记录。
